sentence: This project develops reactions that crosslink parts of proteins and nucleic acids and studies how the reactions work.
This project gets a scanning electron microscope to examine the textures and compositions of minerals and glasses.
This project tests how changing antibodies with unique amino acids affects proteases that are involved in cancer development.
This project uses machine learning on sediment metal and fish fossil data to predict where deep-sea sediment is rich in rare earth elements.
This project creates courses on building automation, energy storage, production controls and cybersecurity for control systems.
This project builds systems that let networked cameras learn from one another, send video more efficiently and combine their views.
This project builds a miniature imaging system that tracks brain activity and cerebrospinal fluid movement through an intact skull in freely moving animals.
This project brings research-grade instruments into biology courses to investigate photosynthesis and carbon cycling from chloroplasts to ecosystems.
This project builds machine learning models for computer vision that explain their reasoning to human users and let users correct mistakes.
This project studies how to make in-memory computing work reliably despite imperfections in memory devices and circuits.
This project draws up a strategic plan and mission for a natural site in coastal South Carolina to guide research there.
This project uses molecular dynamics simulations to study how labeling reagents interact with proteins and whether they change protein structure.
This project gets a sequencing instrument that reads DNA and RNA samples to study plant, microbial, animal, soil and human genomics.
This project uses drones with several sensors to map seagrass in Northern California and to detect disease and changes in seagrass health.
